content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to convert seconds into a minutes and seconds format on the text display? For example, turning 114 seconds into '1 minute and 54 seconds' on screen.
If you adjust the timer settings to show minutes instead of just seconds, the minutes format will be displayed on the text display.
I have a scenario where there are 27000 seconds and 200 pieces, which results in 135 seconds per piece. I want to show this in minutes and seconds (see attached image).
Try using the 'Insert a scale time into the message' feature. [IMAGE] This will display the time in your message as desired. [IMAGE]

In your project, if you've used a mathematical calculation and need to show the value as a formatted time, you can use a timer block (for example, a stairway lighting switch block). Connect your calculated seconds value to the timer block, enable the block by setting the high status bit, and then display the timer's remaining off-delay value in your message. See example: [IMAGE]
Thank you [user_name], it was that simple! I tested this and it works well. Also, thanks to [user_name]—your suggestion seems to work too.
For issues like this, [company_name] provides the 'Insert a scale time into the message' function.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants wanted an easy method to convert and show calculated time in seconds as a readable minutes:seconds display on the text screen. Initially, there was some confusion, but users found that a built-in function allows for straightforward formatting, improving satisfaction once discovered.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to display time data in minutes and seconds automatically on the text display, without needing complicated calculations or settings.
